behavior: Approve and cancel share service authorization: exact plan tenant, matching workshop tenant when present, and workshop owner with write role or explicit operator role.
Other same-tenant writers receive 403; foreign tenants and plans without tenant identity receive 404.
The workshop owner can differ from the plan author. Operator decisions retain plan ownership while recording the actual caller in audit and approval records.
Viewer writes are denied even in permissive stub mode, with both injected and default write-role checks.
General private reads and research dispatch remain unchanged. Operators may decide tenant-scoped plans whose workshop session is absent; other callers require a persisted workshop ownership record.

validation.coverage: Mounted and direct service approve/cancel matrix; owner, operator, author/approver, reviewer, admin, viewer, foreign tenant; rejected calls leave plans, audit and published events unchanged; existing CAS, dispatch, outbox and provenance regressions.
validation.updated_regression: The former same-tenant operator approval=404 expectation now expects 200 while retaining private read isolation assertions.

delivery: Independent review and supervisor integration pending; no hosted deployment claim.
